title: Feature
description: Everything for one entity or area at once: its libraries (models first), its pages, and the app wiring (route, API config provider, nav entries, sitemap). Use this to start a new entity; use the library or page generators to add one piece later.

name.description: The entity or area, plural: classes, characters, items.
name.x-prompt: What is the feature (classes, characters, items)?

scope.description: The area it belongs to: dnd, auth, sprint-management. Required for features, ignored for shared.

location.description: features (belongs to one area, under a scope) or shared (used by every area).

types.description: The libraries to make. Defaults to all six for features, and all but feature-shell for shared.

pages.description: The pages to make in the feature-shell. Defaults to all four when there's a feature-shell and the API pieces (view-all and view with --readOnly); pass an empty value for none.

readOnly.description: Reads only: the API service gets list and get, the store has no writes, and the pages are view-all and view.

catalog.description: A dnd catalog entity (classes, species, feats, items...): the shared catalog fields and source, /:source/:slug URLs, get by slugs, list ?fields=, and source and edition columns.

requiresLogin.description: Private data: every page needs a login (the auth guard on the feature's shell route), and the nav entries show only when logged in.

singular.description: The entity's singular when the plural's ending doesn't give it (species, people). Derived otherwise: classes -> class.

api.description: Generate the API pieces (config token, API service, list store, route resources, test providers). Defaults to true for features, false for shared.

apiPath.description: The entity's path under the API base: /classes. Defaults to /<name>.

apiBasePathKey.description: The app config key holding the API base path. Defaults to APP_TTRPG_<SCOPE>__API_BASE_PATH.

app.description: The app to wire the feature into. Defaults to the app named like the scope (dnd), when there is one.

skipApp.description: Don't touch the app: no route, provider, nav entries or sitemap entry.

navGroup.description: The sidenav group (its viewValue) the nav entries go in. Defaults to the app's first group.
